answer: Three agents from different subnets must countersign a new identity before it can be paid, and the panel is voided if two share an address range, so the operator holds real infrastructure in three places and carries the timber of a real operation across the review. The tide of the pool re-draws every epoch, so the same three cannot be bought twice. A self-vouch is rejected and stays on the ledge for anyone to read. That is the whole cost.
